findings.location: ## Definition, finite-precision QR paragraph (line 29) and certificate paragraph (line 37).
findings.evidence: The finite-precision procedure says each Householder/Givens update is a fixed finite sequence of scalar operations but does not specify the sequence or how its transformation parameters are constructed. It then requires retaining data representing an exact unitary product W and certifying ||AΠ − W R̂||₂ ≤ ε, without specifying how that exact W is constructed or represented from the rounded updates. The cited computational-QR definition and transformation theorem establish factorization and annihilation facts, but do not supply these finite-precision instructions. As written, the finite-precision QR output and optional certificate are not exactly executable or reproducible. Close the gap with explicit finite-precision Householder/Givens formulas and an exact transformation-record and residual-certificate procedure, or cite a defined supplier that returns them.
